title: Separate Sort from Filters and allow empty filter sets
description: Make the Elementor Filter Controller accept zero filter rows and move Sort into its own deeper Content section.
objective: Let Filters be completely removable, make Sort a first-class widget section, and support structured custom sort options without breaking legacy sort values.
inputs_required: Guilherme report that Filters cannot be fully removed
Guilherme request that Sort become separate and deeper like Filters
Elementor local Control_Repeater default prevent_empty=true evidence
expected_outputs: Filters repeater can be empty in the Elementor widget.
Admin preset filter rows also preserve an empty filter set.
Editor Style cadence treats zero visible filter rows as a valid state.
Sort controls live in a standalone Content section.
Sort options can be configured through structured repeater rows.
Runtime accepts custom data-key sort values while preserving legacy values.
acceptance_criteria: The user can remove all rows from the Filters repeater.
An empty preset no longer recreates a default Search row in the admin form.
Removing all filters clears type-specific Style sections without requiring a reload.
Sort no longer appears inside State & Pagination.
A sort option can target a custom data key such as price with number ascending or descending behavior.
Existing sort values like title_asc, date_desc, numeric_desc, and rating_desc remain valid.
verification: JS syntax check passes for editor, frontend, and admin assets.
PHP lint passes for plugin PHP files.
SortOptions isolated PHP smoke test passes with WP function stubs.
git diff --check passes in root and plugin.

budgets.context_budget: Filter Controller content controls, runtime sort resolver, editor save bridge, and docs
budgets.research_budget: local Elementor repeater control source plus plugin code
budgets.validation_budget: syntax, lint, composer, isolated helper smoke, static diff checks

risks: Elementor visual behavior for empty repeaters still requires Guilherme QA in the live editor.
Admin preset Sort UI still uses legacy sort textarea and can be improved in a later dedicated admin slice.
Custom data-key sort depends on listing items exposing usable data-eit-* or data-* attributes.
